Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min compact preview & overlapping availability

Hi Samir — great talk earlier. Quick recap and a suggested next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute product preview that shows the same flows we went over (ingest -> inference -> cost/latency dashboard) but in a tightly scoped script targeted at the ML and infra folks.

Key callouts from today: 
- Primary goal: validate performance assumptions for your 2–4s latency P90 on your 2k daily active inference jobs.
- Stakeholders likely to attend: Leah Park (CTO) + Head of ML.
- Procurement will want an initial SOW/PS estimate after the demo.

Can you confirm who would join from NovaLabs? To make scheduling easier, here are three compact timebands across next week — each 30 minutes:
1) Tue 10/20, 09:30–10:00 PT
2) Wed 10/21, 13:00–13:30 PT
3) Thu 10/22, 16:00–16:30 PT

If you have overlapping windows that work better (e.g., Leah is only available mornings), let me know that overlap window and we’ll adapt. Also let us know if you prefer the short preview followed immediately by a 60-minute technical deep dive; we can schedule as a back-to-back option.

Attaching a short PDF with my call notes from today and a proposed 30-minute agenda.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), redwood-30min-preview-agenda.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0123

Of your three options, these overlap windows work for us:
- Tue 10/20, 09:30–10:00 PT — best for Leah
- If that slips, Thu 10/22 morning (we can do 09:00–09:30 PT) but the second option you listed in the afternoon on Wed is tough.

Can you send a calendar invite for Tue 10/20 09:30 PT with a short agenda and a link to any pre-read? Diego will want to see any perf samples / token-level cost assumptions ahead of time.

On a separate note — if the compact preview looks good, we’ll want a follow-up technical deep dive (60m) with infra and platform owners; happy to schedule that separately after the preview.

Best,
